overview.en:
Use Confluent’s official global MCP to discover environments and clusters, inspect connectors, query metrics and perform authorized connector maintenance.

Inspect pipeline components and their configuration before proposing maintenance. Keep the source, destination, and environment clear when investigating data-flow issues.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Confluent 官方全局 MCP 发现环境与集群、检查连接器、查询指标，并执行已授权的连接器维护。

提出维护建议前检查管道组件与配置，调查数据流问题时明确数据源、目标端和环境。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this data pipeline's available configuration and components.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个数据管道的可用配置与组件。

starterPrompts.en: Investigate this data-flow issue and identify the next diagnostic steps.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 调查这个数据流问题，列出下一步诊断步骤。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a maintenance plan for this pipeline before changing configuration.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个管道准备维护方案，先不要修改配置。

descriptions.en: Use Confluent in Ghast. Use Confluent’s official global MCP to discover environments and clusters, inspect connectors, query metrics and perform authorized connector maintenance. 通过 Confluent 官方全局 MCP 发现环境与集群、检查连接器、查询指标，并执行已授权的连接器维护。
